title.narrative: Promoting Peace and reconciliation amongst border communities in Cyangugu/Rwanda,Bubanza/Burundi,Buk

description.narrative: This project aims to contribute to the peaceful coexistence of communities living in Cyangugu (Rwanda), Bukavu & Uvira (DRC) and Bubanza (Burundi) dioceses. Countries in the African great lakes sub-region region have experienced repeated wars in the recent years that have created mistrust between cross-border people. A peaceful coexistence will be achieved by reducing mistrust between the populations. To achieve this, CDJP Cyangugu will establish diversified exchange and dialogue frameworks and sensitise communities on peaceful coexistence through exhibitions; as well as implementing drawing for peace with students and introducing cross-border pairings of schools and institutions in order to enhance peaceful cohabitation within the youth. The project will also facilitate learning and exchange through workshops with stakeholders across the border, in coordination with Bukavu and Uvira dioceses.
